meaning: The thing measured in minutes, hours, days and years; a particular moment.
examples: What time is it?
I don't have much time today.

meaning: A human being; one man, woman or child.
examples: She is a very kind person.
The ticket costs ten dollars per person.

meaning: A period of twelve months, or 365 days.
examples: We moved here last year.
My son is six years old.

meaning: A method of doing something; a road or path to a place.
examples: This is the best way to learn.
Can you tell me the way to the station?

meaning: A period of 24 hours; the time when it is light outside.
examples: I study English every day.
It was a hot day.

meaning: An object, idea or event that you do not name exactly.
examples: Put your things in the bag.
That's a strange thing to say.

meaning: The earth and all the people and places on it.
examples: She wants to travel around the world.
It is the tallest building in the world.

meaning: The time between being born and dying; the way someone lives.
examples: He lived in the same town all his life.
City life is very busy.

meaning: The part of the body at the end of the arm, with fingers.
examples: Wash your hands before dinner.
She held the cup in her left hand.

meaning: A piece or section of something larger.
examples: The first part of the film was boring.
Music is an important part of my life.

meaning: A young person who is not yet an adult.
examples: The child is playing in the garden.
They have three children.

meaning: One of the two parts of the face that you see with.
examples: She has blue eyes.
Close your eyes and relax.

meaning: A particular area, building or position.
examples: This is a nice place to live.
Put the book back in its place.

meaning: To do a job or activity, usually to earn money.
examples: My father works in a hospital.
I worked hard all week.

meaning: A period of seven days.
examples: I see my grandmother once a week.
The course lasts three weeks.

meaning: Something that is difficult and needs to be dealt with or solved.
examples: We have a problem with the car.
Can you solve this math problem?

meaning: A word or symbol such as 1, 2 or 3 used for counting.
examples: What is your phone number?
A large number of people came.

meaning: Several people or things that are together.
examples: A group of students waited outside.
We worked in groups of four.

meaning: To create or produce something.
examples: She made a cake for my birthday.
Don't make so much noise.

meaning: To have information in your mind; to be familiar with someone.
examples: Do you know the answer?
I have known her for ten years.

meaning: To use your mind; to have an opinion or belief.
examples: I think it will rain tomorrow.
Think carefully before you answer.

meaning: To get hold of something and carry or move it.
examples: Take an umbrella with you.
It takes an hour to get there.

meaning: To notice something with your eyes.
examples: I can see the sea from my window.
Did you see that film?

meaning: To move towards the speaker or a place.
examples: Come here, please.
She came to the party late.

meaning: To wish to have or do something.
examples: I want a cup of tea.
Do you want to go for a walk?

meaning: To turn your eyes towards something to see it.
examples: Look at this photo.
You look tired today.

meaning: To do something with an object for a purpose.
examples: Can I use your phone?
We use this room for meetings.

meaning: To discover something you were looking for.
examples: I can't find my keys.
She found a job in London.

meaning: To hand something to someone so they have it.
examples: He gave me a book.
Please give me your address.

meaning: To say something to someone; to give information.
examples: Tell me about your day.
She told us a funny story.

meaning: To say something as a question to get an answer.
examples: Can I ask you a question?
He asked me for help.

meaning: To experience an emotion or a physical sensation.
examples: I feel happy today.
The water feels cold.

meaning: To make an effort to do something.
examples: Try to arrive on time.
I tried the soup and it was good.

meaning: To go away from a place or person.
examples: The train leaves at six.
I left my bag at home.

meaning: To phone someone; to give someone or something a name.
examples: I'll call you tonight.
We called the dog Max.

meaning: Of high quality; pleasant or helpful.
examples: This is a good book.
She is good at drawing.

meaning: Recently made, bought or started; not old.
examples: I bought a new phone.
We have a new teacher this year.

meaning: Coming before all others in time or order.
examples: January is the first month of the year.
Was this your first visit to Paris?

meaning: Having a great length or lasting a lot of time.
examples: She has long hair.
It was a long meeting.

meaning: Very good; very large or important.
examples: We had a great time.
He was a great leader.

meaning: Small in size or amount.
examples: They live in a little house.
I have a little money left.

meaning: Having lived or existed for a long time.
examples: My grandfather is very old.
This is an old church.

meaning: Large in size or amount.
examples: They have a big garden.
That's a big problem.

meaning: Far above the ground; above the usual level.
examples: The mountain is very high.
Prices are high in this city.

meaning: Not the same as another person or thing.
examples: The two sisters are very different.
Let's try a different way.

meaning: Little in size or amount.
examples: The shirt is too small for me.
She lives in a small village.

meaning: Having great value or effect; mattering a lot.
examples: Sleep is important for your health.
I have an important meeting today.

meaning: The clear liquid that falls as rain and that people drink.
examples: Can I have a glass of water?
The water in the lake is cold.

meaning: At all times; every time.
examples: She always drinks coffee in the morning.
I will always remember this day.

meaning: Many times; frequently.
examples: We often go to the beach in summer.
How often do you exercise?

meaning: At no time; not ever.
examples: I never drink coffee at night.
She has never been to Japan.

meaning: A building where people live, usually one family.
examples: They live in a big house near the park.
Come to my house after school.

meaning: A person you know well and like.
examples: He is my best friend.
I met a friend for lunch.

meaning: A place where children go to learn.
examples: My daughter walks to school.
What did you learn at school today?

meaning: A group of people who are related, such as parents and children.
examples: I have a big family.
We spend Sundays with my family.

meaning: To make it easier for someone to do something.
examples: Can you help me with this box?
She helped her brother with his homework.

meaning: To begin doing something; to begin happening.
examples: The film starts at eight.
I started learning English last year.

meaning: To take part in a game or sport; to make music with an instrument.
examples: The children play football after school.
He plays the guitar very well.

meaning: Not difficult; simple to do or understand.
examples: The test was easy.
This recipe is quick and easy.

meaning: With each other; in one place or group.
examples: We work together in the same office.
Let's have dinner together.
